name: Zecori
author: BeFeast
description: Remaining AI subscription limits, reset times and today's spend per machine, read from your Zecori instance.

barWidget.description: One bar icon with the tightest remaining allowance and one panel: every account's limit windows with reset countdowns, plus today's usage by client label.

schema.label: Zecori instance URL

schema.label: Device token file
schema.description: File holding the device token; owner-only (mode 0600). Issue one with POST /api/device-tokens as a tenant admin.
